title: 導覽阿伯 Tō-lám A-peh
mood: the question nobody asked for thirty years
subject: an old miner giving the same tour every day until a child asks if he was afraid
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien rock built around documentary field recordings. Real-sounding field samples of mine-cart wheels on rails, dripping tunnel water and a guide's distant voice woven between sections, a rock band of raspy overdriven guitar, plain unfussy drums and electric bass playing under and around the samples. Unpolished and documentary, with the field recordings audible as part of the arrangement rather than as effects. Raspy male voice, plain-spoken and conversational, like someone telling it rather than performing it. 108 BPM, A minor. The question nobody asked for thirty years. No synth, no autotune, no enka-style weeping, no big ballad section, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
礦坑博物館 一張票 一百箍
導覽的阿伯 頭戴礦工帽 帽仔頂彼葩燈 猶會著
伊講伊十五歲 就落坑 做三十冬
伊講甲真輕鬆 親像咧講別人的代誌

[Chorus]
導覽阿伯
伊逐工 講仝款的故事 予無仝款的人聽
遊客翕相 遊客行
伊留佇坑口 等下一團

[Verse]
有一个囡仔 問伊「你敢會驚」
伊停一下 頭一擺停落來
伊講「驚 逐工都驚 驚甲袂記得驚」
伊隨閣繼續 講下一站

[Chorus]
導覽阿伯
伊逐工 講仝款的故事 予無仝款的人聽
遊客翕相 遊客行
伊留佇坑口 等下一个 問伊敢會驚的人

[Outro]
礦工帽頂彼葩燈
伊共伊關掉 落班
